benchmark_contract.clock: Enter at each ETF strategy account's first actual execution-session adjusted open; mark at adjusted closes; liquidate at its identical final close.
benchmark_contract.account: Each curve has separate initial NAV 1 before the first session, zero cash yield, no leverage, fractional adjusted units.
benchmark_contract.entry_cost: fee=5/10000; purchased notional=1/(1+fee); shares=notional/first adjusted open; entry fee=notional*fee.
benchmark_contract.exit_cost: Final gross holding=shares*final adjusted close; deduct gross holding*fee and liquidate.
benchmark_contract.returns: First return=first recorded NAV/1-1. Subsequent returns=current NAV/prior recorded NAV-1. Do not rebase first close to1.
benchmark_contract.distributions: Use existing consistently adjusted OHLC; no separate dividend credit, avoiding double counting.
benchmark_contract.timing: If the first strategy decision is cash, benchmarks still enter at that same first scheduled execution open; do not postpone benchmarks to first positive strategy trade.
benchmark_contract.scope: No aggregate portfolio, new model version, simulation of strategy signals, new data acquisition, fitting or reserved-period analysis.
